english.title: Permit the use of leaded paint earlier than three weeks after providing declaration/body not satisfied with content
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),being a person who intended to use leaded paint and provided a relevant declaration under paragraph 3(b) of Part 1 of Schedule 5 to the REACH Enforcement Regulations 2008 to the competent body, namely

(A)_[English Heritage,]_
(B)_[Cadw,]_

permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use the paint

(C)_[earlier than 3 weeks after providing the relevant declaration to that body]_
(D)_[when you had received a notice under paragraph 7(a) of that Part to the effect that the body was not satisfied with the content of the declaration]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(4) and 12 of the REACH Enforcement Regulations 2008.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who intended to use leaded paint
and provided a relevant declaration under paragraph 3(b) of Part 1 of Schedule 5 to the Regulations to the competent body
